items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I know that Duke Ellington played there... like with Duke, like Duke Ellington had been doing.

ctx.x: Uh huh. I have some recollections of meeting your mother when I was with Cab Calloway's band in the early days. We were playing there during the time your folks were in Tuskegee.

Well, that very well could have been -- because during the second world war, there was a man named [Bulls] who had a nightclub off campus there at Tuskegee, and he brought many of the big bands who were traveling, who would play there in Tuskegee. I know that Duke Ellington played there, and Cab -- and that's when you probably met my mother.
